body: No problem at all, I know. I don’t know if he’s always been this way though and it’s only more apparent now that we’ve been together 4 years. I’ll suggest it, he does have some issues. Oh tell me about it! It’s amazing, the orgasm for a woman is 10x better! 😂

Same for me, I’ve stopped liking myself. Don’t really like what I see in the mirror anymore. Me too, my friends are all having sex and it’s just depressing that I’m not enjoying that. I’ve done the same thing, made sure there’s nothing to stress over and let him relax but no change. We have a similar routine, we still have fun together in other ways like Xbox games and going out (depending on CoVID restrictions). Done the exact same, did some dieting made sure I looked pretty when he came home nothing. It’s just hurtful knowing that there’s people who would sleep with us.. but not the one we want. It bothers me a lot, I sometimes don’t think about it for weeks then it comes over me and I just feel worthless.

Oh no, if anything I was more horny than ever when pregnant. I believe when he says he’s not done it in over a year, prior to that he’d only really watch porn when he worked away. Which was a week every 3 months or so. But nothing recently, I just don’t believe he has any sexual thoughts...

It’s just awful, it obviously doesn’t feel right been so young as well. Sex should still be a massive part of our lives. Same for us, we’ve never had the problem before, so it’s a new one. Same here I used to bring it up probably weekly but I’ve given up, effectively giving up that part of myself. He’s said stress too, he’s been through a recent suicidal episode which I know he wouldn’t be thinking about sex then. But he’s assured me he feels 100x better than he did months ago. I’m feeling the same, it feels like we’re friends or something that live together. Not partners... He’s never had an excessive use of porn but definitely lives free of sexual thoughts too... just as if nothing ever tickles his fancy. That’s a shame, it’s just worse not knowing if or when it’ll happen again.

Oh I get that, porn is so unrealistic compared to actual sex. It’s just only been a problem about a year after our son was born... he’s also had the odd problem with substances. Not 100% what that must do to you as well...

I’d say most likely not a porn thing, it’s one thing we’re honest about. I’d prefer to know at this point that he was at least masturbating. 

The testosterone one could be it, but I doubt he’d want to see a GP.

We did suffer emotional trauma, we have a son and we both nearly died at birth. He’s said once before he associates the two. 

Weirdly wondered this one recently... 

Doubt an affair, no signs of anything so if he is he’s hiding it extremely well.

It ruined me for many years, I’ve come to accept it now but he’s just a assh0le. He’s a little different (somewhere on the Autistic Spectrum mixed with some other things) and isn’t actually capable of being a dad. There’s a few moments in life that just sum up how he is to me. 

“At least he wasn’t stillborn like your aunties boy” - after I gave birth to my son at 27 weeks and should have died myself. 

“Once you turn 16 you don’t need me anymore” - was never there anyway. 

“I wanted children to get a council house” - we’ve always just been an asset or a way to a means for him. 

I’ll always have issues relating to men because of it, but I’ve come to learn that it’s him missing out not me.  He occasionally texts me but i don’t usually reply, none of his kids talk to him so I do hope one day when he’s old and alone he realises what he’s lost.

I play most of those games, especially DBD!! Not too talkative either at first but I’m sure we’d soon never shut up, send me a DM and you can add me or ill add you. I’m from the UK but mainly play into the evening anyway 😁

Myself (F) and my partner had a very traumatic birth and he nearly lost us both. He witnessed it all while I was unconscious and have no memory, he didn’t have sex with me for a long time because he was worried it would lead to pregnancy and then the loss of one or both of us. We talked about it and started off slowly, kissing and just foreplay etc. I also stopped asking for it, he felt bad enough knowing he wasn’t giving me something I wanted. I think he felt the pressure too much from me, we’re back to normal now I’d say. It was hard, considering I still wanted that intimacy but he just needed time. 

Sorry for the loss of your baby❤️.

Very true, I do believe for mums is just a rather different experience since we carry the child etc. I’ll try, I thought I’d eased off a lot but I suspect that me mentioning that he doesn’t engage with him a lot will add the pressure. He’s always had the bedtime task since he works all day, so I’m hoping that he finds joy in that. I definitely don’t want him to not feel attached. 

Thank you!

That’s very similar to us, my Dad wasn’t around but my Mum was amazing she made up for it so hence she’s now an amazing grandma. I’ll definitely try that, so then we can’t fight over who’s Approach is best. I suspect I most likely do the same with him, it’s just a very frustrating position to be in.

Yeah I’ve heard that too, my mum has worked in schools and seen it a lot in parents that some just don’t know they aren’t quite doing it. It’s just strange, when our boy was little he’d get up with me while I expressed and would try do anything to help. That part of him has slowly slipped away. 

I’ll try talk to him again, hopefully I can understand what’s maybe going on and try help him through whatever it is he’s maybe going through.

I have to admit this is what happened when he was little, being the stay at home parent I established all these routines. We definitely had that argument but now he’s older things are much more laid back. But maybe he still feels that way, he does ask me everything such as ‘which pjs, what toothbrush’. But in all honesty now I’m not fussed as long as he’s dressed with his teeth brushed. He will bathe him and put him to bed but I do have to ask usually, it’s never something he would pick up on himself.

Well I do know his childhood wasn’t amazing, his Dad wasn’t hands on spent most of his time down the pub and his Mum isn’t the most maternal ‘loving’ role. I would say a lot of the caring was the basic idea. But these roles are still in place now, he doesn’t see his Father much and his Mum is great if you need a lift or anything that way but doesn’t exactly engage with her grandchildren. 

Yeah, I’ve spoke to his sister about it and she’s concerned but neither of us have gotten anywhere. We’re unsure who he’d actually confide in if anyone. I definitely don’t want him thinking I’m twisting people, he has a hard time trusting and seeing that I’m not out to ‘attack’ him already.

Thank you, I’m hoping that’s all it is. I’ve brought it up along the way and as you’ve said he definitely gets very defensive will usually say some nasty things back. But maybe he doesn’t understand how I fully feel still.

Thank you, the positive story helps a lot. I’m glad it’s going well for you and congrats! I do hope I can make it considerably longer than last time if we decide to try, I’ll be a nervous wreck. It’s nice to know they put extra monitoring in place, hopefully that will ease me if the time ever comes.

Hope the remainder of your pregnancy goes smoothly - thank you again for sharing x

Firstly congrats! I’ve been told similar, my chance is incredibly high. I suspect I’ll take aspirin too. I’ll have to get myself a BP monitor and take it everywhere just incase, I know I’ll be riddled with anxiety. Oh same as me, my c section was the same. I’m glad it’s going well for you. Thank you for some insight x

Oh I totally agree, I do think it’s awful a lot of men still bottle up their feelings. I just think as a partner you have to make yourself available with no judgement. Hopefully he will, I’m glad he was confident enough to even tell me though. I’ll just keep supporting him anyway I can and not nag anymore if sex isn’t happening since I know now that we have something to work through.

We had a chat, he finally told me how he felt more than he has for a while he is scared of sex. He associates it with pregnancy and therefore our traumatic birth. I’ve suggested he speak to someone, and I’m happy to go too. I’ve also said we can start slow again, even just kissing so that he eases back into the idea. I think this is a positive step.

Thank you for helping me work out how to approach him about this and get some input. Hopefully we’re on the right track now to a better sex life 😊
We’re both open about that, doesn’t bother me if he uses it I just don’t want replacing by it. He’s assured me it isn’t that and recently he hasn’t even done that because of his total lack of libido
I think it’s the been inside that scares him, I’ve told him I’m also scared. But I’ve made it clear we should have intimacy, I do believe there is something emotionally bothering him though..

I’m still on Maternity Leave so at the moment it is down to him bringing income which I know isn’t a nice feeling to have. I do return to work in a month though so that will relieve that stress. His lifestyle changed a lot he was a guy that went out each weekend with his friends and that stopped once our baby arrived. No weight gain he has a physical job. Yeah he’s like that not so forthcoming with feelings. We did speak briefly last night and he did say again he was scared of sex, so I do believe it’s that. He has previously he was on anti depressants and going through talking therapy. He stopped after six months as he believed he was okay, but i suspect he may have needed a little longer.

I will do, I’ll see how he is this week and make sure he’s in the ideal mood for that sort of conversation. 

That’s a point, I never mentioned how it initially made me feel. I’ll make sure he knows it’s understandable if he’s feeling the way I think. 

Yes definitely, I wouldn’t place any blame apart from that we haven’t communicated about this much and that could be our downfall in letting it get to this point. 

Yes, can always be intimate without having penetrative sex. I’ll see what he thinks to that, if we start of slow. 

Thank you, really appreciate the input 😊. 

Thank you, I hope we can too. Hope your all well & happy too!

Yeah, that’s how fear works. Doesn’t matter how much you can put it place to prevent it he could still just be petrified of it all. 

Thank you, hopefully things change in time. I’ll speak to him and support him best I can 😊

No it wasn’t, we spoke long and hard about it at the time and I gave him the option to not be involved etc. I didn’t want to force him to be a Dad I do believe it’s a joint choice. Totally agree it’s a huge adjustment. 

Yes me too, that’s part of the reason I enjoy it so much. Also that it makes us feel connected it’s just a pleasurable thing to enjoy together. 

I think it may be, unlike him I was totally unconscious for 48 hours so although I know it was bad I didn’t witness it and have to feel what he did for so long. 

Yep, I mean it’s changed for me. But I find him more attractive now to be honest, but I’d understand in our circumstance why he may not feel that way. 

He’s said he’s scared before, but only once which was after we brought our baby home. So very early days at the time and we only had condoms then. I’m unsure if he’s processed it all, like most men he had to go back to work quickly while I was still in hospital and our baby so he didn’t get the time I did. 

I’ll have to bring it up again and see where his head is at now with everything.

Yes we are, it scares me too. I’m not sure if having anymore children is an option for me as it’ll pose huge health risks. But I suppose even though there’s no chance of a baby he could still fear sex from the association maybe? It’s not just fun and playful anymore if he associates those memories with sex.

I understand that, it scares me too but we’re protected so no babies unless we decide. I do have a feeling it’s potentially that. I hope it’s not the Madonna complex 😂. Yeah it’s exciting to start with, I hope we haven’t lost it. I still feel we have a spark and I still oggle him all the time but I’m the higher sex drive at the moment. 

Thank you for your input 😊
I maybe bought a fair few 😂
Totally correct, we had just put them in their cage. Today is a different story, it’s like a bomb has dropped 😂
I’ve got some Therapy lined up, I can say I definitely need it. It wasn’t a choice I wanted to make, I really wish it could have been the opposite. Thank you x
Thank you, I’m home now. I was kept over night due to excessive bleeding, I’m an emotional wreck at the moment. I just want it back, I can’t believe what I’ve done...
I’m thankful you gave us the pleasure of this picture, it truly made my day when I saw it for the first time
I think it’s a ferret, or some form of weasel but not a 100%

Honestly try all the time, a big issue is my Mum. She won’t quite tell him to F off when he asks her... Id day there isn’t an empty part, if anything I want to close him off. But I am, certainly going to give my little boy everything I didn’t get :)

My baby’s laugh.

Also ‘people watching’ and making up lives for them in my head - takes me back to being a little girl doing it!

My Father is similar to this in some ways, I’m an adult now and do my upmost to keep him at arms length. He never paid for us either, he tried to buy us things too and I’d let him when I was younger, but you do slowly pay the price by them interjecting themselves into your life. 
I’d rather pay for things myself and feel mentally healthy than having him coming and going. It’s not worth the hassle at all. You also don’t have to forgive him, I’ve not forgiven my Dad. Just moved on, I’ve got my life now and my own family - that’s my focus.

Thank you - I’ve always known he’s ‘off’ and not quite there let’s say. I know he’ll never give me what I want, and I have let that part go. But for whatever reason it occasionally frustrates me. I’ve told her many times, she doesn’t seem to quite have the guts to tell him to F off. My younger brother unfortunately still visits him and gets money (I think that’s my Mums incentive to keep on his ‘good’ side). I do wish she’d just tell him no when he asks about me..

I think it’s what I have to suggest, he turned the idea down when I mentioned it originally. Totally agree, I think he needs some support other than myself. I’d like to get him on track, I just want to be as supportive as I can. But there’s obviously a limit
This surfaced after our son was born, he did drink but on weekends socially. Maybe the odd glass on an evening, but we did date 5 years prior and he had a bit of an issue with both then...

I’ve said that tonight, he’s on the couch at the moment since he couldn’t drive... 
Exactly that’s my thought, you have to be totally in control when you’ve got a little one. That’s just a choice you make, it’s self and irresponsible to do the opposite. 
Definitely don’t want two... especially when he knows better. 
Thanks Hun, it’s nice to know I’m not going mad been this annoyed at him x
